#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int u, v, c, r;
    Edge(int uu, int vv, int cc, int rr) : u(uu), v(vv), c(cc), r(rr) {}
};

vector<Edge> E;
vector<vector<int>> ady;

int maxflow(int source, int sink) {
    int total_flow = 0;
    while (true) {
        vector<int> prev(ady.size(), -1);
        vector<int> prev_edge(ady.size(), -1);
        queue<int> Q;
        Q.push(source);
        while (!Q.empty()) {
            int u = Q.front(); Q.pop();
            for (int i = 0; i < ady[u].size(); ++i) {
                int e = ady[u][i];
                int v = E[e].v;
                if (E[e].c <= 0 || prev[v] >= 0) continue;
                Q.push(v);
                prev[v] = u;
                prev_edge[v] = e;
            }
        }
        if (prev[sink] < 0) break;
        int bottleneck = INT_MAX;
        for (int x = sink; x != source; x = prev[x]) {
            int e = prev_edge[x];
            bottleneck = min(bottleneck, E[e].c);
        }
        for (int x = sink; x != source; x = prev[x]) {
            int e = prev_edge[x];
            E[e].c -= bottleneck;
            E[E[e].r].c += bottleneck;
        }
        total_flow += bottleneck;
    }
    return total_flow;
}

void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, bool directed = true) {
    Edge e1(u, v, cap, E.size() + 1);
    ady[u].push_back(E.size());
    E.push_back(e1);
    Edge e2(v, u, directed ? 0 : cap, E.size() - 1);
    ady[v].push_back(E.size());
    E.push_back(e2);
}

const int MAX_N = 11;
int n, t;
char grid[MAX_N][MAX_N];
int scientists[MAX_N][MAX_N];
int capsules[MAX_N][MAX_N];
int dx[4] = {1, -1, 0, 0};
int dy[4] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

int dist[MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N];

void bfs(int sx, int sy) {
    memset(dist, -1, sizeof(dist));
    queue<pair<int, int>> Q;
    Q.push({sx, sy});
    dist[sx][sy][0] = 0;
    
    while (!Q.empty()) {
        auto cur = Q.front(); Q.pop();
        int x = cur.first, y = cur.second;
        
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
            if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n) {
                if (grid[nx][ny] == 'Y') continue;
                
                for (int d = 0; d <= t; ++d) {
                    if (dist[x][y][d] == -1) continue;
                    int new_d = d + 1;
                    if (new_d > t) continue;
                    
                    if (dist[nx][ny][new_d] == -1) {
                        dist[nx][ny][new_d] = dist[x][y][d] + 1;
                        Q.push({nx, ny});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n >> t;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> grid[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> scientists[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> capsules[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    // Find all reactor positions
    vector<pair<int, int>> reactors;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') {
                reactors.push_back({i, j});
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Calculate infection time for each cell
    vector<vector<int>> infect_time(n, vector<int>(n, INT_MAX));
    queue<tuple<int, int, int>> Q;
    
    for (auto& r : reactors) {
        int x = r.first, y = r.second;
        infect_time[x][y] = 0;
        Q.push({x, y, 0});
    }
    
    while (!Q.empty()) {
        auto [x, y, time] = Q.front(); Q.pop();
        if (time >= t) continue;
        
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
            if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && grid[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                if (infect_time[nx][ny] > time + 1) {
                    infect_time[nx][ny] = time + 1;
                    Q.push({nx, ny, time + 1});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Build flow network
    int source = 0;
    int sink = 1;
    int lab_node = 2;
    int total_nodes = 2 + n * n;
    
    ady.assign(total_nodes + 1, vector<int>());
    E.clear();
    
    // Connect source to each lab with scientists
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] != 'Y' && scientists[i][j] > 0) {
                int node = lab_node + i * n + j;
                add_edge(source, node, scientists[i][j], true);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Connect each lab to sink with capacity = capsules
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] != 'Y') {
                int node = lab_node + i * n + j;
                add_edge(node, sink, capsules[i][j], true);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Connect adjacent labs
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') continue;
            int node = lab_node + i * n + j;
            
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = i + dx[k], ny = j + dy[k];
                if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && grid[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                    int neighbor = lab_node + nx * n + ny;
                    add_edge(node, neighbor, 1000000, true);
                    add_edge(neighbor, node, 1000000, true);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Calculate max flow
    cout << maxflow(source, sink) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
